# Audio

`cinnabar:extension/audio@0.1.0`

Local named-sound suppression.

**Grants:** `audio`.

## Types

## Functions

<a id="set-muted-sounds"></a>

### `set-muted-sounds`

```wit
set-muted-sounds: func(names: list<string>) -> result<_, string>;
```

Replaces this instance's retained set of exact sound-definition names.
At most 64 names of 1–128 ASCII identifier bytes (letters, digits, _, ., :, /, -).
Empty clears the set. Commits only after a successful callback; revoked on unload,
quarantine, world change or permission loss. Multiple instances combine by union.
Applies to queued, decoding and playing sounds, including managed loops.
